values.value: Makes your Nonprofit Cloud households (Party Relationship Groups of type Household) BarnCRM households on the same accounts, once, with a preview, a confirmed count and an undo. Nonprofit Cloud groups, memberships and accounts are never deleted or changed.

[{"key":"households","label":"Convert Nonprofit Cloud Households","kind":"tool","help":"On BarnCRM Settings, General, use Convert Nonprofit Cloud Households: preview, confirm the number and run it. Each household account becomes a BarnCRM household in place, and with household membership set to membership records each member joins it. Then come back here and click Mark Done.","tab":"BarnCRM_Settings","toolLabel":"Open BarnCRM Settings"}]

[{"key":"entry","text":"Ask staff to add and change household members on the BarnCRM household, so households are no longer kept in both places."},{"key":"naming","text":"If you use Nonprofit Cloud's automatic household naming, turn it off, so BarnCRM alone names the converted households."},{"key":"layouts","text":"Remove the Nonprofit Cloud household and group membership related lists from the page layouts staff use, once the BarnCRM household cards are on them."},{"key":"drift","text":"Open Health Check and settle any account it lists under Household Model Disagrees With Nonprofit Cloud."}]
